preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 4 and 1000 inclusive.
The maximum allowed number of roads k is between n-1 and 2n-2 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len({a, b, c, d}) == 4 and all(1 <= x <= n for x in [a, b, c, d])
preconditions.description: The four cities a, b, c, d are distinct integers between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1\n' or (len(path1) == n and len(path2) == n and set(path1) == set(range(1, n+1)) and set(path2) == set(range(1, n+1)) and path1[0] == a and path1[-1] == b and path2[0] == c and path2[-1] == d and (a, b) not in [(path1[i], path1[i+1]) for i in range(n-1)] and (b, a) not in [(path1[i], path1[i+1]) for i in range(n-1)] and (c, d) not in [(path2[i], path2[i+1]) for i in range(n-1)] and (d, c) not in [(path2[i], path2[i+1]) for i in range(n-1)] and len({tuple(sorted((path1[i], path1[i+1]))) for i in range(n-1)} | {tuple(sorted((path2[i], path2[i+1]))) for i in range(n-1)}) <= k)
postconditions.description: If impossible, output -1. Otherwise, output two lines representing valid Hamiltonian paths: the first starts at a and ends at b, the second starts at c and ends at d. Both paths must visit every city exactly once. The direct edges (a,b) and (c,d) must not exist in their respective paths. The total number of distinct undirected edges used by both paths combined must not exceed k.
